description: This file defines a utility enum `GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport` that manages gateway selection logic within an application. It provides functions to apply remote gateway selection based on discovery info, determine preferred transport types, and decide whether to prefer direct transport based on gateway attributes.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Sets the remote URL and target in app state based on the discovered gateway, and updates the config file with the remote gateway's address if available.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Determines the preferred transport type for a gateway, defaulting to direct if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Decides whether to prefer direct transport over other types based on the gateway's URL and host attributes.
